system.description: Snobbish god of excellence and of Elves and Eldarin, teaching they are the finest of all peoples; he rejects failure yet holds that only quitting counts as failing.
system.summary: Snobbish god of excellence and of Elves and Eldarin, teaching they are the finest of all peoples; he rejects failure yet holds that only quitting counts as failing.
commandments: Bring beauty to everything you do, from spells to songs to war.
Recover lost magic, forgotten rites and ancient art that he may have inspired.
Show no mercy to those crushed beneath your rise; failures earn no pity.
directives: Protect your community and resist outside change to your ways.
Take part in art rather than merely consuming it.
Make hard things look easy and be an example to others.
Create beauty and honor it everywhere, even in enemies.
Reject meekness and shame in favor of confidence.

cults.name: Elvpax
cults.summary: Elf-supremacist extremists, almost all Elves or Eldarin, who kill for 'crimes against elves' and push discriminatory laws.

cults.name: Elfaboos
cults.summary: Non-elves obsessed with elven culture; a few move to elven worlds and are grudgingly tolerated.
